2-11-24
The claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes and described contact along the passenger side of the
vehicle. The claimant mentioned a knee injury from the impact and said they were not represented by a lawyer.
3-24-24
Photos taken at the scene confirm some of the details the claimant gave, although no independent witnesses have
come forward. The police report and the people who stopped to help both confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at
the time.
5-29-24
The damage to the vehicle is mostly in line with the impact described, and the pattern of the scrapes and dents fits a
sideswipe. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the damage predates the start of
coverage. The driver is named on the policy.
7-11-24
The reported knee injury matches the kind and force of a crash like this one. No earlier injury to the same body area
is known from the claimant's history or prior claims.
9-8-24
The claimant has given the same account of the accident in every conversation so far, including the sequence of the
lane change and the point of contact. Treatment has followed a usual course, with visits tapering off as the claimant's
knee improved.
9-10-24
Based on the photos, the statement, the police confirmation, and the medical timeline, the file is consistent and no
open questions remain on liability or the reported injury. The claim is ready for the next review step.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
